messages.text: BL-2097 🎵 in progress — A long poll that never answers is abandoned before the supervisor kills the bot: BL-2072's timing lines name the stalling phase - all 84 slow lines from 11:26Z to 13:53Z on 2026-10-09 are getUpdates waits of 27-93 s against a 25 s long poll, and the bot waits for the answer with no deadline of its own, so a wait past 90 s gets the bot killed as stalled and hands getUpdates to the bridge
